source: Shared memory also has costs. It consumes finite per-ZXNAME0000XZ capacity, can reduce block residency, requires correct synchronization when threads communicate, and has banked access behavior that can serialize some patterns. Those bank-conflict details belong to AS08.
zh: 共享内存也有成本。它消耗有限的 per-ZXNAME0000XZ 容量，可以减少块驻留，在线程通信时需要正确的同步，并且具有可以序列化某些模式的存储访问行为。这些银行冲突详细信息属于 AS08。
